I did not write this but I am tired...so very tired.  

Black people are so tired. 😓

We can’t relax in the comfort of our own homes (#BothemSean and #AtatianaJefferson). 

#BlackLivesMatter

We can’t sleep (#AiyanaJones)

#BlackLivesMatter 
#LivingWhileBlack

We can’t hold a hair brush while leaving our own bachelor party (#SeanBell).

We can’t party on New Years (#OscarGrant).

We can’t get a normal traffic ticket (#SandraBland).

We can’t lawfully carry a weapon (#PhilandoCastile).

#BlackLivesMatter 
#LivingWhileBlack

We can't break down on a public road with car problems (#CoreyJones).

We can’t shop at Walmart (#JohnCrawford) .

We can’t have a disabled vehicle (#TerrenceCrutcher).

We can’t read a book in our own car (#KeithScott).

#BlackLivesMatter 
#LivingWhileBlack

We can’t run (#WalterScott).

We can’t breathe (#EricGarner).

We can’t live (#FreddieGray).

We’re tired. 

Tired of making hashtags.

Tired of trying to convince you that our #BlackLivesMatter too. 

Tired of dying.

Tired.

Tired.

Tired.

So very tired.

Well said @KamalaHarris! 

It is sad that this has to be said.
